findings.message: The identification header gives the Vorbis version 1; Vorbis I requires 0, and decoders refuse other versions, so the audio packets are only counted.

The identification header gives the block sizes 32 and 2048; the Vorbis I specification allows 64 to 8192 with the first not larger than the second (section 4.2.2), so decoders refuse the stream and its audio packets are only counted.
The identification header's framing bit is 0; libvorbis 1.3.7 refuses the header.
The identification header gives 0 channels; the Vorbis I specification requires at least one, and decoders refuse the stream.
